entry.title: 2036/23 [esc] amends 1502/10, 1506/06, 1546/09
entry.content:
These regulations rescind and replace the earlier Economic Service Charge regulations published in Gazettes 1502/10, 1506/06 and 1546/09. They allow businesses in specified sectors to opt for prescribed quarterly turnover calculations, including special calculations for freight forwarders, certain exporters and primary dealers, and then calculate Economic Service Charge on that turnover. The document does not state a commencement or effective date.
Amends 1502/10 — Economic Service Charge Act.
Amends 1506/06 — Economic Service Charge Act - Amendment to gaz.Ex.No.1502/10 of 20.06.2007.
Amends 1546/09 — Economic Service Charge Act No. 13 of 2006 - Amendment to Gaz. Ex. No. 1506/6 of 18.06.2007.
Effective from 2017-09-13.
Affects: businesses liable to the Economic Service Charge.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2017_2036-23_E.pdf

entry.title: 1857/09 [esc] amends 1502/10, 1506/06, 1546/09
entry.content:
This regulation changes how eligible persons or partnerships may calculate Economic Service Charge when they choose the turnover-based option. It applies different statutory rates to quarters ending on or before 31 March 2011, quarters ending on or before 31 March 2012, and quarters commencing on or after 1 April 2012, replacing the previous single-rate reference. The change is stated to apply to relevant quarters commencing on or after 1 April 2007.
Amends 1502/10 — Economic Service Charge Act.
Amends 1506/06 — Economic Service Charge Act - Amendment to gaz.Ex.No.1502/10 of 20.06.2007.
Amends 1546/09 — Economic Service Charge Act No. 13 of 2006 - Amendment to Gaz. Ex. No. 1506/6 of 18.06.2007.
The current document in this rule is now 2036/23 (2017-09-13).
Effective from 2014-04-09.
Affects: businesses liable to the Economic Service Charge.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2014_1857_09_(E).pdf

entry.title: 1546/09 [esc] amends 1502/10, 1506/06
entry.content:
This amendment changed the Economic Service Charge turnover calculation for specified exporters and primary dealers for quarters beginning on or after 1 April 2008, generally using the relevant export margin or securities margin instead of gross turnover. The position was later amended by 1857/09 and replaced by 2036/23: the replacement rules allow qualifying businesses to opt for these specialised turnover calculations and set the applicable charge under the later statutory schedules, while also covering freight forwarders.
Amends 1502/10 — Economic Service Charge Act.
Amends 1506/06 — Economic Service Charge Act - Amendment to gaz.Ex.No.1502/10 of 20.06.2007.
The current document in this rule is now 2036/23 (2017-09-13).
Effective from 2008-04-22.
Affects: businesses liable to the Economic Service Charge.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/20081546_9(E).pdf

entry.title: 1506/06 [esc] amends 1502/10
entry.content:
This gazette expanded an optional Economic Service Charge turnover calculation method to businesses covered by regulations 03 or 04, for quarters starting on or after 1 April 2007. As amended by Gazette 2036/23, the earlier regulations were later rescinded and replaced with rules covering specified freight-forwarding, export and primary-dealer businesses, including alternative turnover formulas and applicable statutory rates.
Amends 1502/10 — Economic Service Charge Act.
The current document in this rule is now 2036/23 (2017-09-13).
Effective from 2007-07-18.
Affects: businesses liable to the Economic Service Charge.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/20071506_6(E).pdf

entry.title: 1502/10 [esc] rescinds 1447/10
entry.content:
The regulations replace the earlier 1447/10 rules for calculating Economic Service Charge turnover. As amended by Gazettes 1506/06, 1546/09, 1857/09 and 2036/23, eligible businesses may use specified turnover calculations for freight forwarding, qualifying exports and primary-dealer activities, and may calculate the charge using the applicable statutory rate for the relevant quarter. The latest amendment, 2036/23, rescinds the earlier version and replaces it with revised rules, including an option to use the prescribed calculations.
Rescinds 1447/10 — (recovered from the Internet Archive; not in the IRD listing).
The current document in this rule is now 2036/23 (2017-09-13).
Effective from 2007-06-20.
Affects: businesses liable to the Economic Service Charge.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/20071502_10(E).pdf

entry.title: 1447/10 [esc] new: (recovered from the Internet Archive; not in the IRD listing)
entry.content:
The original regulations required qualifying freight forwarders to deduct certain cargo-carriage payments when calculating turnover for Economic Service Charge purposes, and removed the usual non-chargeability where quarterly turnover did not exceed Rs. 10 million. These regulations were later rescinded by Gazette 1502/10 on 20 June 2007, without undoing actions already taken; for quarters beginning on or after 1 April 2007, the replacement rules allow specified businesses, including freight forwarders, to use revised turnover calculations and provide related supporting statements.
The current document in this rule is now 2036/23 (2017-09-13).
Effective from 2006-05-30.
Affects: businesses liable to the Economic Service Charge.
Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20241121131108if_/http://www.documents.gov.lk/old/gazette/forms/Extgzt/2006/Pdf/May/1447-10/1447-10e.pdf
